# Lexio Phonos

Private English pronunciation practice with guided listening, recordings and a local journal.

- [Current setup and data contract](../README.md)
- [Audit and validation](../docs/AUDIT.md)
- [Student roadmap](../docs/ROADMAP.md)
- [Contributing](../CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [Issues](https://github.com/talles-dt/lexio-phonos/issues)

Student practice does not require a database. Use Node 22.12+ or 24, run `npm ci` and `npm run dev`. Consult the root README before using optional legacy database maintenance commands.
